Draft 1 - sampled
Both of you should know what was found and why no money moves. WHAT THE RECORD SHOWS. The GPS trace (EV-GPS-02859, weight 1.0) ran 92.0 km between the recorded pickup and drop-off. It is complete — 834 fixes at a 10-second interval, 100.0% coverage, no gaps, maximum gap 0.0 s — so it is not impaired under POL-RD-07(a) to (c), and its figure agrees with the trip record's 92.0 km. The booking-time optimal route on the trip record (EV-TRIP-02859, weight 1.0) is 22.0 km. The excess is 70.0 km, or 318.18% of optimal: both POL-RD-01 establishment tests (over 0.8 km and over 20%) and both materiality tests (over 8.0 km and over 50%) pass. The deviation is established and MATERIAL on this trip's own evidence. The meter time supports it — 138.8 minutes charged against a 30.0-minute optimal. NO EXCUSE APPLIES. The chat log (EV-CHAT-02859, weight 1.0) holds zero messages, so there is no rider instruction and no waypoint_hint: POL-RD-04 cannot be run at all, and nothing is excluded from the excess. No pickup or drop-off amendment was recorded (both amendment timestamps and amended_optimal_distance_km are null), so POL-RD-05 yields no amended optimal. The vehicle type is RYDE_X, so the pooled-trip clause POL-RD-12 does not apply. The only traffic advisory (EV-ADVIS-02859-01) is admissibility-MISSING with weight 0.0 and issue MISSING_ARTIFACT, so POL-RD-03 is unavailable and the driver's assertion of an external cause carries no weight under POL-RD-08 and POL-RD-13. I record that the assertion was made, that no advisory was on file, and that it does not reduce the excess. THE ARITHMETIC. The fare is METERED (EV-FARE-02859, weight 1.0). Under POL-RD-02: recomputed_fare = ((SGD 3.80 base fare + 0.75 x 22.0 km + 0.28 x 30.0 min) x the 2.0 surge multiplier read from fare_breakdown.surge_multiplier) + SGD 0.80 platform fee = (SGD 28.70 x 2.0) + SGD 0.80 = SGD 58.20.
